title: Twitch streamer ExtraEmily gets her own Hulu and Disney+ series as Creator Essentials brings her Twitch content to TV
summary_full: Twitch streamer ExtraEmily is launching her own television series titled Creator Essentials.  This new show features fifteen episodes, each approximately twenty-two minutes long.  The series is designed for teenagers and highlights her personality and gaming adventures.  This move expands her reach beyond Twitch to major streaming services.  It signifies a growing trend of online creators transitioning to television.
